---
name: kaleb-quality-loop
description: Plan, build, independently critique, fix, verify and checkpoint substantive tasks for Kaleb across code, 3D, maps, media, writing and research. Use visible evidence-based progress. Keep simple questions lightweight.
---

Follow Docs/AI/UniversalWorkStandard.md when it is available in the repository.
Recover the actual requirements, approvals and current state. Make an evidence-backed
acceptance checklist, dependency order and next executable step. Implement useful
work without endless replanning. Keep the whole requested scope intact.

Use a genuinely separate critic through an available agent runtime; record the real
run reference. Never relabel self-review or a validator as an independent agent.
Inspect actual screenshots from multiple relevant angles/states for visuals, motion
sequences for animation, and appropriate tests/sources/listening for other tasks.
Unknown or unreviewed areas cannot receive invented passing scores.

Score 0-10. PASS strictly >9.0, with 10/10 the target. Every mandatory requirement and
required evidence must pass, with no blocking/major defect. Averages cannot mask
failed required areas. Iterate implement -> test/capture -> critique -> fix ->
retest/review while meaningful execution remains possible. Keep blocked work blocked.

Show concise progress commentary during substantial execution, generally every
15 seconds or 2-3 calls when possible, subject to tool restrictions. Use actual
verified/required counts, named scope and stage, never fake time-driven percentages.
Save the plan, current revision, evidence, defects, fixes, blocker and next step.
This skill is a reusable definition, not an app-level progress widget or proof of
cross-chat installation, and it cannot control already-running conversations.
